agency: U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Accountability
title: Hearing: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena - Exposing the Truth (House Oversight joint subcommittees, 13 Nov 2024)
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of a joint congressional hearing regarding UAPs, containing multiple reports of encounters and claims of government concealment.

encounters.summary: Navy pilots encountered unidentified objects during a 2015 exercise off the U.S. East Coast, leading to near midair collisions and an urgent safety warning.
encounters.entity_behavior: exhibiting flight and structural characteristics unlike anything in our arsenal
encounters.quote: If any of you know what these are, tell me ASAP.

encounters.summary: A UAP was observed by watch standers on the USS Omaha off Southern California, exhibiting transmedium travel by entering the water from the atmosphere.
encounters.entity_appearance: aloft object with no observable exhaust or control surfaces
encounters.entity_behavior: entered the water from the atmosphere
encounters.quote: saw it enter the water from the atmosphere

encounters.summary: A large equilateral-triangle UAP appeared directly over ships at night in the Pacific Ocean, observed by vessels engaged in SIGINT and MASINT collection.
encounters.entity_appearance: large equilateral-triangle with three bright points at each bottom corner
encounters.entity_behavior: slowly rotate on its horizontal access
encounters.quote: large equilateral-triangle UAP suddenly appears directly over the ships

encounters.summary: An F-22 fighter was intercepted and boxed in by multiple metallic orbs while performing an airspace surveillance mission.
encounters.entity_appearance: multiple metallic orbs, slightly smaller than a sedan
encounters.entity_behavior: accelerated at rapid speed, intercepted and boxed in the F-22
encounters.quote: boxed in by approximately three to six UAPs

encounters.summary: A white orb UAP was filmed coming out of the ocean off the coast of Kuwait, later joined by a second orb.
encounters.entity_behavior: coming out of the ocean, joined by another orb
encounters.quote: white orb UAP coming out of the ocean
